title: Restore navigation, Actions and the welcome
summary: Repairs the Chat dock, Actions layout, onboarding controls and visible welcome animation.
changes: Keeps Night, Changes, Actions, Breaks and Chat visible in both the normal and fallback dock.
Restores the Actions sheet layout, readable labels and correctly sized icons.
Separates onboarding progress from Skip and keeps Continue reachable on small phones.
Plays the personal greeting when Night becomes visible, without restarting during background refreshes.
